name: Utsunomiya Shirayuki
source: A third-year young lady who is admired by the younger students as a big sister. In fact, her hobby is streaming video games, and she has become popular because of her elegant aura befitting a young lady. She tries to kick the protagonist out because it is unnatural for a man to manage a female dormitory.
